# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and improves Linux, GTK4, Tizen, and WinUI support. The release restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling, and refreshes the bundled renderer.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156 and incorporates the preceding m155 core fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again discover installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **GTK4 rendering gains native GPU scaling** — Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering support with pixel scaling for sharper desktop output. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen and WinUI build support aligned** — Updates Tizen builds and packaging for GCC 14.2, and restores the WinUI project's default Windows SDK selection. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235), [#5273](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5273))
